slides.heading: What it is
paras: A hand-drawn sketch can become a production-ready 3D animation in under an hour by chaining Procreate → Magnific AI → 3DAI Studio → Move AI → final render. Each tool handles one transformation step.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Khronos glTF-Validator returns zero errors for the animated character.glb, and the Babylon.js sandbox or three.js editor plays the animation.
trimesh reports one watertight body under 30k faces after assembly.
